_notes: OUT-OF-SAMPLE HOLDOUT validation for MyClaude_V61 — run this ONCE, last.
PURPOSE: after the PassA/PassB/PassC mechanics-QA sweeps, you LOCK one final
configuration (PassA winner + PassB winner + PassC winner) in the study. This file
runs that ONE config over the untouched holdout window so you can see whether it
survives out-of-sample. It is the validation step, not another search.
WHY ONLY ONE HOLDOUT FILE (not PassA/B/C.Holdout): re-sweeping on the holdout is
SEARCHING the holdout = peeking, which destroys the whole point. A holdout gets
exactly ONE look at the ONE final config. No re-tuning to it.
WINDOW: startDate = 2026-06-01 (holdout start). The optimizer has NO end-date field
(it reads ONLY startDate and replays to the LAST LOADED CHART BAR), so control the
window via the CHART's data range: load data from a few hundred bars BEFORE
2026-06-01 (for 200-MA / Range Filter / RQK / ATR warm-up) THROUGH today. Replay
then trades 2026-06-01 -> now. (The search passes capped the chart END at 2026-06-01;
here you EXTEND the chart's data END to the latest bar.)
SET MANUALLY in the study before running (optimizer leaves increment-0 inputs alone):
- PassA winner: Range Filter Period (27), Range Filter Multiplier (28), RQK Lookback (29)
- PassB winner: Stop ATR x (1), TP1 (4), TP2 (6), Trail ATR x (8); plus Stop Type (0)=0,
Trailing-after-TP1 (7)=Yes, TP1 Close % (5)<100
- PassC winner: Trend MA (40), Volume Filter (42), Choppiness (32) at their chosen values
- Enable Order Submission (35)=Yes, ALLOW LIVE (36)=No, FLATTEN NOW (39)=No,
Trade >> Trade Simulation Mode = ON
THE SWEEP BELOW IS A 1-COMBO RUN: it re-asserts your locked Range Filter Period so the
optimizer executes EXACTLY ONE replay. Set BOTH min AND max to your PassA-winner value
(shown here as 100 — REPLACE with yours). increment 1 with min==max => 1 combination.
VERDICT RULE (decide BEFORE you look): if holdout P/L flips sign, or Sharpe / Profit
Factor collapses vs the search window, DISCARD the config — it was overfit. Passing
this does NOT certify an edge: the holdout is ~3 weeks / a handful of trades; it only
rules out gross overfit. Certification needs YEARS of OOS, not weeks.
NEVER deploy this config to the live-armed study (real acct 23234705) regardless of result.
